name: Camping 101: Engineering
summary: The Strange Hermit in Shadowgale Forest teaches you to craft a camping item after you show skill as an engineer. The Reagent Bot is meant for use in a wilderness camp.

sections.title: A Wilderness Camp
sections.body: The Strange Hermit in Shadowgale Forest asks you to show proficiency in engineering before teaching you a camping craft. Engineers can put their trade to use while alone in the wilds, where helpful constructs can make a camp complete.

sections.title: Setting Up Camp
sections.body: The Strange Hermit teaches you to craft a Reagent Bot. To start a camp, you also need a campfire, which most cooks can teach you to make. The Hermit warns that townsfolk do not care for camps set up in the middle of town.

faq.q: Who teaches me the camping craft?
faq.answer: The Strange Hermit in Shadowgale Forest teaches you the camping craft after you show proficiency in engineering.

faq.q: What does engineering have to do with camping?
faq.answer: The Hermit says engineers can use their trade in the wilds and craft helpful constructs for a camp.
The Hermit teaches you to craft a Reagent Bot.

faq.q: Do I need anything else for a camp?
faq.answer: You need a campfire to start your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make one.

faq.q: Where should I set up camp?
faq.answer: The Hermit says townsfolk do not care for camps set up in the center of town, so head into the wilderness to test your camp.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can learn to craft a Reagent Bot for a wilderness camp after showing the Strange Hermit your proficiency.
As a cook, you can teach others to make the campfire needed to start a camp.
